title: Jacobian layers and higher Milnor sequences: rigidity, stabilization, and log-concavity
summary: Let $f$ be an isolated hypersurface singularity and let $J(f)$ be its Jacobian ideal. We study the higher Milnor numbers $μ_k(f)=\dim_{\mathbb C}\mathcal O_n/\mathfrak m^kJ(f).$ Our main result concerns an ordinary semi-homogeneous singularity $f=f_r+f_{r+1}+\cdots$, where the projective hypersurface defined by $f_r$ is smooth. We prove that $μ_k(f)=μ_k(f_r) \qquad\text{for every }k\geq0.$ This gives the equal-weight case of a conjecture of Shi, Yau, and Zuo.
